lead.zh: 指挥终端于 {time} 收到一条模拟访问受限信号。
lead.en: The command terminal received a simulated access-hold signal at {time}.

leadError.zh: 这是插件彩蛋，不代表账户实际受限，也不会修改你的数据。
leadError.en: This is a plugin easter egg. Your account is not being restricted and no data is changed.

step1Desc.zh: 终端记录本次演习的启动时间。
step1Desc.en: The terminal records when this drill began.

step2Desc.zh: 演习页面不会连接账户复核服务。
step2Desc.en: The drill does not contact an account-review service.

step3Desc.zh: 关闭页面后继续当前工作。
step3Desc.en: Close this page to continue your work.

exportDesc.zh: 关闭演习页面，回到当前界面。
exportDesc.en: Close the drill and return to the current view.

deleteDesc.zh: 关闭这张彩蛋页面，不会删除账户或数据。
deleteDesc.en: Close this easter egg without deleting your account or data.

banLocaleDesc.zh: 账号行打开的那张彩蛋页，按这里选的语言显示。
banLocaleDesc.en: The account-hold page the account row opens, in the language chosen here.
